== Summary ==
Unscaled source-only text-bar crops from the pinned July2022 and December2022 full Endor faces. Top: complete Dark Side bar regions, losslessly rotated 180 degrees for reading. Bottom: complete Light Side bar regions. SourcePNG commits [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4 44c7bc5c] and [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545 e9980f98]. Cropping does not paint or replace card pixels. This is transcription evidence, not a claim that current rules originated the wording. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
